reader_summary.headline: My guest this week is Rebecca Lynn.
reader_summary.overview: My guest this week is Rebecca Lynn. Rebecca co-founded early-stage investor Canvas Ventures in 2013 and is regularly featured as one of the best VCs in the market. She has deep positioning and go-to-market experience, which she honed during her time at Procter & Gamble, and that's the focus of our discussion.

key_points.text: We cover the details of great marketing, why you should say no to customers, and how she has built Canvas.
Please enjoy my discussion with Rebecca Lynn.
